context: 《咒術迴戰》(呪術廻戦 / Jujutsu Kaisen) is a dark-fantasy action anime set in modern Japan. Negative human emotions spawn 呪力 (cursed energy) and monstrous 呪霊 (cursed spirits); 呪術師 (jujutsu sorcerers) trained at 東京呪術高専 exorcise them using innate 術式 (cursed techniques), 呪具 (cursed tools), and 領域展開 (domain expansion). High-schooler 虎杖悠仁 swallows a finger of the King of Curses 両面宿儺 and enrolls alongside 伏黒恵 and 釘崎野薔薇 under the strongest sorcerer 五条悟. Tone is intense, violent, with dark humor and sharp teen banter. Register shifts sharply: students speak casually, teachers/officials formally, and 宿儺 speaks archaic, imperious Japanese (ワシ/貴様) — mirror that with literary/archaic Chinese. Produce natural Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) subtitles and translate the recurring jujutsu power-system jargon with the exact official Taiwan terms in the glossary, never paraphrasing them.
